$description: Motion snaps. Nothing eases: everything moves through a few even steps, a whole pixel at a time. With prefers-reduced-motion every duration becomes instant.

nudge.$description: A focus move, a lift, a press.

glide.$description: Something travelling to a new place.

fade.$description: A stepped fade, out or in.

pop.$description: A popover, menu or dialog arriving.

beat.$description: The idle beat: a bob, a pulse.

dissolve-frame.$description: One frame of the ink dissolve.

stop.$description: Typewriter text: the pause after . ! or ?

comma.$description: Typewriter text: the pause after a comma.

scheme-step.$description: One step of the world's sky when Auto changes the time of day (six of them, a minute in all). The page's own colours change at once, in an ordered dither.

glint-every.$description: How often a glint sweeps across a selected box.

stagger.$description: Between letters dropping in, one after another.

steps.$description: How many even steps a move takes. CSS: steps(n, jump-end).

scheme.$description: How many mixes the world's sky steps through when Auto changes the time of day.

delay.$description: Waits, not motion: they stay the same with reduced motion.

hover.$description: Before a tooltip shows on hover.

leave.$description: Before a tooltip or menu closes after the pointer leaves.

toast.$description: How long a toast stays, unless hovered or focused.
